detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iRxOccupancy returns the number of 32-bit words available (occupancy) to be read from the receive channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iRxOccupancy returns the occupancy count in 32-bit words for the specified FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Returns the next receive frame length in bytes.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iRxGetLen notifies the hardware that the program is ready to receive the next frame from the receive channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr.
Note that the program must first call XLlFifo_iRxGetLen before pulling data out of the receive channel of the FIFO with XLlFifo_Read.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iRxGetLen returns the number of bytes available in the next frame.

briefdescription.para: Reads aligned 32-bit words from the receive FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iRead_Aligned reads WordCount words from the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr to the block of memory referenced by BufPtr.

XLlFifo_iRead_Aligned assumes that BufPtr is already aligned according to the following hardware limitations: ppc - aligned on 32 bit boundaries to avoid performance penalties from unaligned exception handling. microblaze - aligned on 32 bit boundaries as microblaze does not handle unaligned transfers.

Care must be taken to ensure that the number of words read with one or more calls to XLlFifo_Read() does not exceed the number of bytes (rounded up to the nearest whole 32 bit word) available given from the last call to XLlFifo_RxGetLen().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the memory address to place the data read.
Specifies the number of 32 bit words to read.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iRead_Aligned always returns XST_SUCCESS. Error handling is otherwise handled through hardware exceptions and interrupts.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iTxVacancy returns the number of unused 32 bit words available (vacancy) in the send channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iTxVacancy returns the vacancy count in 32-bit words for the specified FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Starts a transmit of the given byte length.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iTxSetLen begins a hardware transfer of data out of the transmit channel of the FIFO specified by InstancePtr. Bytes specifies the number of bytes in the frame to transmit.
Note that Bytes (rounded up to the nearest whole 32-bit word) must match the number of words just written using one or more calls to XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the number of bytes to transmit.

briefdescription.para: Writes aligned 32-bit words to the transmit FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned writes WordCount words to the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr from the block of memory referenced by BufPtr.

XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned assumes that BufPtr is already aligned according to the following hardware limitations: ppc - aligned on 32 bit boundaries to avoid performance penalties from unaligned exception handling. microblaze - aligned on 32 bit boundaries as microblaze does not handle unaligned transfers.

Care must be taken to ensure that the number of words written with one or more calls to XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned() matches the number of bytes (rounded up to the nearest whole 32 bit word) given in the next call to XLlFifo_iTxSetLen().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the memory address of the data to write.
Specifies the number of 32-bit words to write.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_iWrite_Aligned always returns XST_SUCCESS. Error handling is otherwise handled through hardware exceptions and interrupts.

briefdescription.para: Initializes the XLlFifo driver from a config.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_CfgInitialize initializes an XPS_ll_Fifo device along with the InstancePtr that references it.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the AXI Streaming FIFO instance to be worked on.

Device base address in the virtual memory address space. The caller must keep the mapping from EffectiveAddr to the physical base address unchanged after this call. If address translation is not used, pass Config->BaseAddress as the physical address.

briefdescription.para: Reads one 32-bit word from the receive FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_RxGetWord reads one 32 bit word from the FIFO specified by InstancePtr.
XLlFifo_RxGetLen or XLlFifo_iRxGetLen must be called before calling XLlFifo_RxGetWord. Otherwise, the hardware raises an Over Read Exception.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XLlFifo_RxGetWord returns the 32 bit word read from the FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Writes one 32-bit word to the transmit FIFO.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_TxPutWord writes the 32 bit word, Word to the FIFO specified by InstancePtr.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Data word to be written to FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Initializes the XLlFifo driver from a base address.

detaileddescription.para: XLlFifo_Initialize initializes an XPS_ll_Fifo device along with the InstancePtr that references it.

parameterdescription.para: References the memory instance to be associated with the FIFO device upon initialization.
Processor address used to access the base address of the Fifo device.

detaileddescription.para: The Xilinx local link FIFO driver component. This driver supports the Xilinx xps_ll_fifo core.
